headline: Conversion fell nearly evenly across all regions; no single confirmed cause yet.
body: The drop is broad-based: West, East, North, and North-West each lost about a fifth of the total decline, roughly equal shares. That uniformity argues against a region-specific driver and points toward something systemic. Marketing spend and tracked sessions both show weak movement with the KPI, so neither corroborates the decline. An unvalidated lead ties this to a North-West warehouse failure and SLA breaches, but no evidence yet supports or refutes it.
what_could_change: Confirmed SLA breach logs or churn timing data tied to the North-West warehouse incident would validate or rule out the lead.
caveats: Confidence is capped because no supporting evidence dataset was available, only the aggregate signal; regional split alone can't isolate a cause.
clarifying_question: Can you provide SLA breach or enterprise churn records for late June to test the warehouse-failure lead?
escalation_brief: Marketing conversion dropped uniformly across all regions in July with no corroborating driver data; a warehouse-failure hypothesis is unverified and needs SLA/churn evidence before action.
